summary: accumulate lazily produces each successive accumulated result.
documentation: accumulate lazily produces each successive accumulated result. Addition is the default operation. Without an initial value, its first result is the first input item, and empty input produces no results.
inputs: An iterable and optional combining function/initial value.
returns: An iterator of running accumulated values.
caution: Supplying initial adds an extra output item. Do not insert a starting zero unless the required output asks for one.
scenarios: Show a running balance after each ledger adjustment.
Track completed units as each production batch arrives.
title: Compute running balance changes
problem: Input is a list of integer adjustments in cents. Return cumulative sums after each adjustment, beginning with the first adjustment. Do not prepend a zero. Negative adjustments reduce the running amount.
goal: Use itertools.accumulate() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Import accumulate and materialize its default addition results.
